text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
All the fans were cheering for me and
had big
smiles on their faces!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It was almost like the stands were a
garden full of
blooming flowers!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Heehee. I'm happy to have made you
proud,
Trainer!
choice_data_list: That's how incredible your run was!
Let's bloom with smiles next time too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you to help me keep up
with my
training so that I can repeat that
kind of
performance!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Right! I'll do my best to bring joy to
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
All right, I've got to get back into my
training
starting tomorrow!
